What’s more, management **lowered full-year 2026 guidance** to **$3.60–$3.90 diluted EPS**, which tells you the market likely viewed the quarter as weaker than the prior-year setup and the outlook as less certain.

The one constructive note was **free cash flow**: AOS reported **$118.9 million of free cash flow**, up from **$17.4 million** in Q1 2025, which was a real strength in an otherwise soft quarter.

**Bottom line:** If you mean “beat” in the usual sense — **EPS and revenue above consensus** — the answer is **no**. The market reaction also looked negative after the release, so sentiment was not helped by the print.
